text:
Grok Bot is quietly becoming the most useful AI product.

It can interview you, learn your context, and run a repeatable workflow. Now the agents are shareable with your personal data removed. 

They gave me early access, so I built two shareable bots.

1) PITCH DECK ANALYZER

I get pitched 5–10 times a week. This bot learns exactly what I look for, analyzes each deck against my preferences, and helps me quickly filter out opportunities that don’t fit my investment criteria.

2) AI USAGE METER

If you use multiple AI tools, you know how annoying it is to check every subscription just to see how much usage you have left. This bot tracks it all for you in one place.

That’s what makes Grok Bot exciting.

It doesn’t just talk. It learns your situation, runs a workflow, evolves with you, and becomes more useful over time.
